finding.text: The demo is meant to show "one part of each of the six types", but only three blocks say which type they are. The part-link card shows its target's title ("ITEM README, AS PARTS") instead of the `title: "part-link"` the line gives it, and the part-file block has no label at all (page 8) — shots/…-parts-types/1920.png, middle band.

The `t-live` card is now a permanent line in `types/page.jsonl`, yet it says "This line was appended after the page loaded". That stops being true for anyone who opens the page later (content 11) — shots/…-parts-types/1920.png, last card.
`Meter.js` sets the bar's width, height and background as inline styles. The height and the background are static, so they belong in a class or token; only the width needs to be inline (layout 42).
The Parts page reaches the new Part types page only through the sidebar. Its own content has no link or part-link to `types/` (content 8) — shots/…-parts/sheet.png.
PageView and PageFile are new classes with no page that lists their live instances. They hold no state worth watching, so this is only a note (rules: show the class).

On the demo you can't tell which block is which type at a glance (requirement 3; content: one takeaway per demo). part-link and part-file get a separate grey code label above them. part-card and part-view name themselves in their own title. part-heading and part-text have no label at all. The part-link line's own title "part-link" is also replaced by the linked page's title, "Item readme, as parts" (PageLink shows the child's first line). One small label above each of the six blocks would fix it. Evidence: shots/…-parts-types/1200.png, middle band.

The part-file block drops `notes.md`'s own `# A markdown file, drawn in place` heading. The block then starts mid-thought ("This block is notes.md…"). Evidence: shots/…-parts-types/1200.png, part-file band.

The demo's `doc/types-1200.png` is the same file as `doc/live-before.png` (same md5). So the committed 1200 shot shows the page without the "Added while open" card, which `page.jsonl` now holds. The live proof itself stands: live-before and live-after differ.
`types/Meter.js` sets its bar's height and background with inline `.style(...)` instead of a class in CSS. That is fine for a tiny demo module, but it is the first example agents will copy.
